text: It may be worth examining whether feeling a need to pull away when a relationship gets close is connected to a reflex to guard what you love. This could indicate that you're sensitive to the potential loss or hurt that comes with deepening a connection. One possibility is that your Baseline quality of holding and protecting what matters is also what you're trying to protect in your relationships. This could mean that you're not just pulling away from the other person, but also from the vulnerability that comes with intimacy.
